scenarioName: Stroke - Unknown Type — Right-Sided Weakness and Aphasia

scenarioStory.history: Wife noticed sudden onset of right facial droop, right arm weakness, and inability to speak clearly approximately 45 minutes prior to EMS arrival while eating breakfast. Patient was last seen speaking normally at the start of breakfast, roughly 45 minutes ago. No witnessed trauma, no seizure activity, no head strike.
scenarioStory.course: Initial Contact: Crew arrives to find a 72-year-old male seated at the kitchen table with obvious right facial droop and right arm weakness. He is alert but unable to produce clear speech. Wife reports normal function 45 minutes ago. → Stroke scale and LKW obtained: Crew completes a focused stroke assessment: positive facial droop, right arm drift, and absent speech consistent with a positive stroke scale. LKW time is confirmed as 45 minutes ago. BGL is checked and is normal, ruling out hypoglycemia as the cause. → Stroke alert transmitted, transport initiated: Patient is packaged and transported to an appropriate stroke center given the severity of findings and LKW within the thrombolytic and thrombectomy treatment windows. Hospital notified early with a stroke alert including LVO suspicion.

relatedChecklist: Check blood glucose; treat only if BGL less than 60 mg/dL
Perform validated stroke scale and severity scale (face, arm, speech)
Determine and document a specific last known well time from bystander
Administer oxygen only as needed to target 94–98% SpO2
Elevate head of stretcher 15–30°; keep head and neck neutral
Acquire 12-lead EKG and place patient on cardiac monitor

scenarioEvents.name: Stroke alert transmitted, transport initiated
scenarioEvents.description: Patient is packaged and transported to an appropriate stroke center given the severity of findings and LKW within the thrombolytic and thrombectomy treatment windows. Hospital notified early with a stroke alert including LVO suspicion.
relatedChecklist: Transmit early stroke alert to receiving hospital including LVO suspicion
Do not treat hypertension; monitor without pharmacologic intervention

scenarioEvents.name: LKW time not established
scenarioEvents.description: Without a precise LKW time, the hospital stroke team cannot confirm whether the patient falls within the thrombolytic or thrombectomy treatment windows, potentially delaying or excluding him from time-sensitive interventions.
relatedChecklist: Re-question bystanders to pin down a specific, defensible LKW time before arrival
